name: paper-espresso
description: Distill an arXiv paper into a dense, mathematical LaTeX digest with source and verified PDF output.

interface.shortDescription: Compress papers into rigorous technical digests.
interface.longDescription: Resolve a paper from its title or arXiv identifier, acquire source safely with PDF fallback, extract a working corpus, and produce a page-budgeted LaTeX source plus density-checked PDF.
defaultPrompt: Distill this paper into a one-page technical digest.
Create a two-page mathematical digest of this arXiv paper.
Explain this paper through its core annotated equation.
